title: TractionCurrentPersistenceDecisionRuleV2
description: Reconciled discrete sampled persistence decision rule for electrical traction de-energization, purging unsupported performance claims and aligning with provisional characterization governance.

discrete_decision_rule_specification.mathematical_formula: forall m in {0, 1, ..., 99}: I_RMS[k* - m] <= I_guarded

PERSISTENCE_PASS.definition: Phase U sliding RMS current satisfies I_RMS[k] <= 0.410 A RMS across 100 consecutive discrete evaluation frames (0.1 ms step, delta_t = 10.0 ms) without any intermediate frame exceeding threshold, with final endpoint declared at t_stable <= 48.8 ms from t0.

PERSISTENCE_FAIL.definition: Phase U sliding RMS current fails to establish 100 consecutive sub-threshold frames within 48.8 ms from t0, OR exhibits an excursion I_RMS[k] > 0.410 A RMS before the 100-frame counter completes.

PERSISTENCE_UNDETERMINED.definition: Acquisition record duration shorter than required evaluation interval, OR digitizer clipping / current probe saturation detected, OR probe degauss offset drift exceeding limits.

unsupported_language_remediation.rationale: Empirical observation across 10 trials cannot be generalized to universal 100% immunity.
Bench observations on 10 trials establish characterization behavior only, not safety certification.

unsupported_language_remediation.reconciled_phrase: DISCRETE_SAMPLED_PERSISTENCE (100 consecutive frames at 0.1 ms step)
unsupported_language_remediation.rationale: Digital signal processing evaluates on a discrete grid; physical continuous claim was technically ungrounded.
